fact.en: Perseverance entered the Mars atmosphere at about 19,500 km/h on Feb 18, 2021. It slowed down with a heat shield, a 21-metre parachute and a rocket 'sky crane', all on its own, because the signal to Earth took 11.5 minutes.
Jezero Crater once held a lake, fed by a river that left a fan-shaped delta. NASA chose it because ancient lakes are good places to look for signs of past life.

Astronauts on the Space Station ate red romaine lettuce they grew themselves. NASA's OSDR study OSD-268 found that it grew in 33–56 days, was safe to eat and was at least as nutritious as lettuce from Earth.
On Feb 6, 2009, wind blew dust off NASA's Spirit rover. Its daily power jumped from about 210 to 240 watt-hours, and the sunlight reaching its cells rose from 25% to 28%.
Opportunity measured the dust in the sky (tau). It is normally about 0.5. On June 10, 2018 it reached 10.8. The rover needed tau below 2 to recharge its batteries.
Opportunity was designed for 90 Martian days and 1 km of driving. It worked for almost 15 years and drove more than 45 km. NASA declared the mission complete on Feb 13, 2019.
Curiosity's RAD instrument measures radiation on the Mars surface: about 0.64 mSv per day, because Mars has a thin atmosphere and no global magnetic field.

cards.source: NASA PDS · Curiosity RAD (Hassler et al. 2014)

title.en: The Speed of Light Is Too Slow

fact.en: Radio messages travel at the speed of light, yet they take 3 to 22 minutes between Earth and Mars. That's why rovers and astronauts must make fast decisions on their own.
In September 2017, a solar storm doubled the radiation on the Mars surface for more than two days. NASA's MAVEN saw an aurora more than 25 times brighter than any before.

On May 20, 2024, Curiosity measured 8,100 micrograys from one solar storm, like 30 chest X-rays, the biggest surge since it landed. NASA says cliffs and lava tubes would give astronauts extra shielding.
DONKI is a NASA database that records every solar flare, CME and particle storm. Our game downloads its last 30 days once a day for the 'Today's Real Sun' chapter.
